items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

ctx.x: Well, that's right. We had a nice wedding.
We married Peter Clayburn Church. Since then, all the time we'd get out of town and we'd travel with Ida Cook, went all down to Florida too then, you remember? Ida Cook. If you were to show.
Did your sister sing much by the way? Oh yeah, all my sisters sing.
